title: Final Discontinuity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the discontinuity in the potential across the dipole layer.

title: Discontinuity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct calculation leading to the expression for the discontinuity in the potential.

title: Surface Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the surface charge density sigma.

title: Dipole Layer Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the dipole layer density tau.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Gauss' law to relate the electric field and charge on the spherical surface.

title: Potential Outside Sphere
description: Optional Criteria: The student should confirm that the potential outside the spherical surface is zero.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating discontinuities or charge densities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
